title: Peephole
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After a failed suicide attempt, shut-in Etsuro Kurosu discovers a hole in his wall through which he watches his neighbor, Rio Miyaichi, and sees her kill a man. He becomes infatuated, enters her world, and the story follows their destructive relationship to a tragic end.
life_message: Isolation and a fascination with death can draw people into bonds that destroy them.
